Bidim A12 non-woven geotextile is a permeable synthetic fabric used in civil construction, roadworks, drainage, retaining walls, landscaping, and erosion control. Its primary purpose is to separate, filter, drain, and protect soil and aggregate layers while still allowing water to pass through.
